# `Q-2-12` — Unclosed Star Emphasis

> A `*emphasized*` run opens with `*` but no closing `*` appears
> before the end of the block.

## What this means

Star-delimited emphasis (`*text*`) must be balanced inside the
same block. This error fires when an opening `*` appears without
a matching close before the block ends.

## Why this happens

A typo, an unclosed sentence mid-edit, or — less commonly — a
literal asterisk in plain prose that the parser took as an
emphasis opener.

## How to fix

Add the closing `*` at the intended end, or escape a literal
asterisk:

```markdown
The marker \* (literal asterisk).
```

## Example

```markdown
foo* a
```
